title: Find Median Given Frequency of Numbers
goal: Find the median of a multiset stored as values with frequencies.
strategy: Sort distinct values and walk cumulative frequencies. The median is the average of the values occupying the two central ranks; an odd total gives the same rank twice. No expanded list is needed.
